hints.title: Count Value Frequencies
hints.text: Iterate through the array and tally the occurrence count of each distinct integer.

hints.title: Compare Total Frequencies to Distinct Frequencies
hints.text: Insert all frequency counts into a set to verify whether any duplicate count occurs.

hints.title: Equality Check
hints.text: The occurrences are unique if and only if the set cardinality matches the total number of distinct elements in the frequency mapping.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise frequency checking takes quadratic time compared to linear set insertion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Using hash tables for frequency counting and set uniqueness yields linear time with linear auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly implement frequency counting and uniqueness validation.
complexity.notes: Elements can be negative, zero, or positive.
